data.name: Manju
data.gender_notes: Manju is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manju is a name that means a precious jewel or gem. It is a name that symbolizes beauty, wealth, and good fortune. In Hinduism, Manju is also a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Manju carries the meaning “Jewel, Gem” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Manju usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Manju is a name that is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune in Hinduism. It is a name that represents the divine feminine energy and the power of abundance and manifestation.
data.etymology: Manju belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Gem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manju total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
